randomness_scope: Ideal bounded draws use fair-bit rejection from the next power of two. The finite run uses independently derived Python Random.getrandbits streams and records every bit trial and rejection.
screen_scope: The paired static screen evaluates six distinct gcd arguments invariant under exchanging the endpoints: endpoint +/-1 for both endpoints, edge difference, and edge sum. Its charged state freezes at first absorption.
solver_isolation: The inner trajectory receives N, a, method, cap, and an independently derived matching seed. Hidden roots and offline factors remain in the outer driver.
